sections.title: Color Dungeon
sections.note: Added in DX, and kept in the Switch remake. DX can't run it on a non-colour Game Boy.

items.name: The book in the Library
items.howTo: Dash into the Library's bookshelf with the Pegasus Boots to knock down a book from the top shelf: it shows how to push the gravestones.

items.name: Open the Color Dungeon
items.howTo: Push the five gravestones in the Cemetery's south-east corner in order: 1 down, 2 left, 3 up, 4 right, 5 up. The stairs appear under the last.
items.notes: Needs the Power Bracelet. Gar and Dion, the skeletons at the door, ask which colour you like on DX; on Switch they sell 20 Magic Powder for 100 Rupees.

items.name: Giant Buzz Blob
items.howTo: Sprinkle Magic Powder on it, then hit it.

items.name: The Fairy's gift
items.howTo: Choose a tunic from the Great Fairy behind the boss: red or blue.
items.reward: Red Mail (double sword damage) or Blue Mail (half the damage taken)
items.notes: DX calls them Red and Blue Clothes; Switch, Powerful Red Mail and Sturdy Blue Mail, from the Fairy Queen. Come back to swap. Green can't be had again on DX; on Switch it can.
